name: Arnor Ravaged
text:
Setup: Add Arnor Ravaged to the staging area with damage on it equal to the amount of damage marked for it in the Campaign Log.
Forced: After an attack damages a character but does not destroy it, move 1 damage from Arnor Ravaged to that character.

name: Intruders in Chetwood
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Attach Iârion's Pendant to Iârion and add the Protect the Innocent side quest to the staging area. Starting with the first player, each player may place 4 damage on Protect the Innocent to add 1 resource to each of their heroes' resource pools.

back.text: Resolution: Note the amount of damage on Protect the Innocent in the Campaign Log and add Protect the Innocent to the Campaign Pool.

name: Iârion's Pendant
text:
Attached character gets +1 Willpower.
Response: Add Iârion's Pendant to the victory display to cancel the 'when revealed' effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck, or to cancel a shadow effect just triggered.

name: Protect the Innocent
text:
Forced: After an attack damages a character, place 1 damage on Protect the Innocent.
When progress would be placed on Protect the Innocent, remove that much damage from it instead.
If Protect the Innocent has 10 or more damage on it (20 or more damage if there are 3 or 4 players in the game), the players lose the game.

name: The Weather Hills
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Add the Mysterious Omens side quest to the Campaign Log and shuffle it into the encounter deck. Add the Protect the Innocent side quest to the staging area and place damage on it equal to the amount of damage noted for it in the Campaign Log.

back.text: Resolution: Note the amount of damage on Protect the Innocent in the Campaign Log (replacing the previous number).

name: Mysterious Omens
text:
Surge.
Forced: After Mysterious Omens becomes the current quest, each player discards 1 random card from their hand.
Forced: When Mysterious Omens is defeated, remove it from the Campaign Pool. Then, each player may choose 1 of the following boons and attach it to a hero they control: Cunning, Hardy, Resolute, Ruthless, or Stalwart.

name: Cunning
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero. Add 2 resources to that hero's resource pool.
Action: Attached hero gets +2 Willpower, +2 Attack, and +2 Defense until the end of the phase. (Limit once per game.)

name: Hardy
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +2 hit points.
Action: Ready attached hero. (Limit once per game.)

name: Resolute
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 Willpower.
Response: Cancel up to 2 points of damage just dealt to attached hero. (Limit once per game.)

name: Ruthless
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 Attack.
Action: Move any amount of damage from attached hero to an enemy engaged with you. (Limit once per game.)

name: Stalwart
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 Defense.
Planning Action: Play an attachment from your discard pile on attached hero. (Limit once per game.)

name: Deadmen's Dike
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Attach Iârion's Pendant to Iârion. Add the Protect the Innocent side quest to the staging area and place damage on it equal to the amount of damage noted in the Campaign Log.
Forced: After Thaurdir enters play, randomly select one of the following burdens and attach it to Thaurdir: Thaurdir's Legacy, Thaurdir's Majesty, or Thaurdir's Spite. Add that card to the Campaign Pool.

back.text: Resolution: Note the amount of damage on Protect the Innocent in the Campaign Log (replacing the previous number) and remove Protect the Innocent from the Campaign Pool. Add Arnor Ravaged to the Campaign Pool in its place (found on the opposite side of Protect the Innocent). The players as a group must select either Iârion's Pendant or Amarthiúl's Courage to add to the Campaign Pool. Any player may add Iârion's Pendant to their deck if it is chosen.

name: Amarthiúl's Courage
text:
Setup: Attach to Amarthiúl. Otherwise, remove Amarthiúl's Courage from the game.
Amarthiúl gets +1 Willpower and +1 hit point.
Action: Ready Amarthiúl. (Limit once per game.)

name: Thaurdir's Legacy
text:
Setup: Attach to Thaurdir (even if he is out of play). Otherwise, remove this card from the game.
Forced: After a Sorcery treachery is revealed, move Thaurdir's Legacy to the hero with the most resources. (Counts as a Sorcery attachment with the text: "Attached hero gets -2 Willpower and is treated as if its printed text box were blank.")

name: Thaurdir's Majesty
text:
Setup: Attach to Thaurdir (even if he is out of play). Otherwise, remove this card from the game.
Forced: After a Sorcery treachery is revealed, move Thaurdir's Majesty to the hero with the most non-objective attachments. (Counts as a Sorcery attachment with the text: "Attached hero gets -2 Attack and cannot commit to the quest.")

name: Thaurdir's Spite
text:
Setup: Attach to Thaurdir (even if he is out of play). Otherwise, remove this card from the game.
Forced: After a Sorcery treachery is revealed, move Thaurdir's Spite to the hero with the most damage. (Counts as a Sorcery attachment with the text: "Attached hero gets -2 Defense and cannot be healed.")

name: The Wastes of Eriador
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Each player may change hero cards without incurring the +1 threat penalty. Each player adds 1 copy of Determination to their starting hand. Add each of those events to the Campaign Pool. Shuffle the Fend Off Despair side quest into the encounter deck.

back.text: Resolution: Add Fend Off Despair to the Campaign Pool.

name: Determination
text: Action: Attach Determination to a unique character. Then, ready each character with a copy of Determination attached, as well as each character who is "determined" in the Campaign Log. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: If you win this scenario, mark in the Campaign Log that attached character is 'determined.'")

name: Fend off Despair
text:
Each event card gains doomed 1.
Forced: When Fend Off Despair is defeated, mark in the Campaign Log that each player's starting threat is reduced by 2. (This reduction is cumulative.)

name: Escape from Mount Gram
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Set aside any permanent boon attachments on heroes that are added to a player's captured deck. Add the Loot the Dungeons side quest to the staging area, capturing the bottom 5 cards of each player's captured deck underneath it. Flip this card over.

back.text:
Forced: Instead of raising their threat by 1 during the refresh phase, each player raises their threat by the number of completed quest cards plus the number of side quests in the victory display.
Forced: After a hero enters play, attach to that hero each set-aside permanent boon attachment assigned to that character in the Campaign Log.
Resolution: Each player must make note of which unique cards are still in their captured deck and not in play at the end of the game. Those cards cannot be included in that player's deck for the rest of the campaign.

name: Loot the Dungeons
text:
Loot the Dungeons is considered to be in each player's staging area and gets +4 quest points for each player in the game at every staging area.
Forced: When Loot the Dungeons is defeated, each player (at every staging area) may choose one of the following boons and add it to their hand: Berelind, Chieftain's Brooch, Coruhaer, Laermuin, Mail of Eärnur, or Silverthorn. Add the chosen cards to the Campaign Pool.

name: Berelind
text: Response: After Berelind attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress on a quest card in play.

name: Chieftain's Brooch
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Each ally that shares a Trait with attached hero gets +1 Willpower.

name: Coruhaer
text: Response: After Coruhaer defends an attack, spend 1 resource to deal 2 damage to the attacking enemy.

name: Laermuin
text: Response: After Laermuin commits to a quest, heal 1 damage from a character.

name: Mail of Eärnur
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +2 hit points.
Response: After a player's threat is reduced, heal 1 damage from attached hero.

name: Silverthorn
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
While attacking or defending against an enemy, attached hero gets +1 Attack and +1 Defense if that enemy shares a Trait with an enemy in the victory display.
Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, add that enemy to the victory display. (Limit once per game.)

name: Across the Ettenmoors
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Set all 5 Losing Time treacheries aside, out of play.
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, place 1 resource on this card. Then, if there are 3 or more resources on it, remove 3 resources from it to reveal 1 set-aside copy of Losing Time and place it in the encounter discard pile.

back.text: Resolution: Add each copy of Losing Time in the encounter deck or encounter discard pile to the Campaign Pool.

name: Losing Time
text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Each player must either raise their threat by 3 or exhaust a hero they control.
shadowText: Shadow: Attacking enemy either gets +3 Attack or +3 Defense until the end of the phase.

name: The Treachery of Rhudaur
text: You are playing campaign mode.

back.text: Resolution: For each Clue a player controls, that player may add the boon with the same name to the Campaign Pool and their deck.

name: Daechanar's Brand
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +1 Attack (+2 Attack instead when attacking an Undead enemy).
Response: After you play Daechanar's Brand, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a Sorcery treachery and add it to the victory display. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: Heirloom of Iârchon
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +1 Willpower.
Response: After you play Heirloom of Iârchon, heal all damage from attached hero.

name: Orders from Angmar
text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +1 Defense (+2 Defense instead while defending against an Undead enemy).
Response: After you play Orders from Angmar, discard a non-unique Undead enemy with 2 or less remaining hit points.

name: The Battle of Carn Dûm
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Each player may change hero cards without incurring the +1 threat penalty, and Amarthiúl may be included among a player's heroes. Then, each player in turn order may select one of the following boons and add it to their opening hand: Elrond's Champion, Lore of Ancient Arnor, Raiment of the Second Age, or Rivendell Skirmishers. Add the chosen cards to the Campaign Pool.

back.text: Resolution: Note the amount of damage on each hero at the end of the game.

name: Elrond's Champion
text: Response: After an enemy engages you, ready Elrond's Champion.

name: Lore of Ancient Arnor
text: Action: Each player returns 1 card from their discard pile to their hand (2 cards instead if you are the only player in the game) and shuffles the rest of their discard pile back into their deck. Then, remove this card from the game.

name: Raiment of the Second Age
text:
Attach to a character. Restricted.
Attached character gets +2 Attack and +2 hit points.
Response: After attached character attacks and destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.

name: Rivendell Skirmishers
text: Response: After Rivendell Skirmishers exhausts to defend an attack from non-unique enemy, discard each shadow card from that enemy.

name: The Dread Realm
text:
You are playing campaign mode.
Setup: Each player may search their deck for a boon card and add it to their opening hand. Each hero begins the game with damage on them equal to the amount noted for them in the Campaign Log.

back.text: Resolution: The players win the campaign!
